rules_forward_need_address: Please enter a valid forwarding address first.
rules_forward_sum_keep: All messages go to {to}. A copy stays in your mailbox.
rules_forward_sum_nokeep: All messages go to {to}. No copy is kept in your mailbox.
rules_err_size: The size must be a number greater than 0.
rules_err_address: Please enter a valid forwarding address.
rules_err_target: Please choose a target for each action.

rules_desc: New messages are checked against the rules from top to bottom.
rules_empty: No rules yet. Rules sort messages automatically as they arrive.

mail_identity_addr_note: The address is set by the server.

mail_identity_empty_text: {host} reports no sender address for this account.

mailpush_quiet: During quiet hours, new emails arrive without sound.
mailpush_fail_on: Push wasn’t turned on. Please try again.
mailpush_fail_off: Push wasn’t turned off. Please try again.
list_empty_drafts_text: Messages you start are saved here automatically.

general_delete_last: Account not deleted. You’re now the only administrator.

general_export_desc: Account and settings as a JSON file
general_danger_desc: Your account and all its data will be permanently removed.

ext_desc_mobile: Images and tracking pixels from external servers in HTML messages.

push_toast_no_decision: No decision was made in the browser

push_denied_step3: Reload the page and try again.

notif_topics_desc_mobile: Choose the channels for each topic.
notif_ch_app_desc: Shown on the bell at the top right

notif_digest_sum_monday_late: One email every Monday at {time} with everything new, at the end of quiet hours
notif_sound_desc: A short sound when a notification arrives while the app is open.
notif_pop_off_text: Turn on in-app notifications to see them here.
org_info: All users see this information under Settings › About. Empty fields are hidden there.

branding_login_art_desc: Floating elements next to the form on large screens
branding_login_art_desc_mobile: Next to the form on large screens

updates_st_no_release_sub: The repository has no releases yet.
updates_err_token: The access token is invalid or expired. Replace it under “Source”.
updates_err_no_access: GitHub denied access to {repo}. If you set an access token, replace it under “Source”.
updates_err_rate_limited: GitHub is rate-limiting requests right now. Try again later.
updates_err_unreachable: GitHub can’t be reached right now. Try again later.
updates_pat_invalid: Invalid token or no access to {repo}.
updates_pat_unavailable: GitHub isn’t responding right now. The token wasn’t saved. Try again later.
updates_pat_remove_text: Without a token, {app} checks for new versions anonymously, and GitHub limits that more strictly. You can add a token again at any time.

updates_pat_hint: Optional. The repository is public; a GitHub token only raises the API rate limit for update checks.
updates_auto_desc: Look for new versions in the background
updates_time_desc: Ideally at night, when things are quiet
updates_display_desc: What users see under Settings › About.
updates_show_desc: Shows whether the app is up to date
maintenance_on_text: Everyone without admin rights will be signed out and will see your notice until maintenance ends.
maintenance_status_on: Active. Only administrators can use the app.
maintenance_bk_restore_text: All data will be reset to its state as of {at}. Any later changes will be lost.
maintenance_bk_restore_note: All devices will be signed out. You’ll stay signed in if your account is active in the backup.
maintenance_bk_now_fail: The backup failed. Check the server’s storage space and log.
maintenance_bk_running: A backup is running right now. Try again in a moment.
maintenance_bk_invalid: This backup is corrupted and can’t be restored.
maintenance_bk_newer: This backup is from a newer version and can only be restored after an update.
maintenance_bk_unverified: This backup comes from an older version or was changed and can’t be restored.
maintenance_bk_other_key: This backup belongs to an instance with a different key (secret.key). Without that key, multi-factor authentication and email accounts would be unusable.
maintenance_bk_maint_required: Maintenance mode is no longer on. Turn it back on to restore the backup.
maintenance_bk_maint_desc: That way nobody changes data while it’s being reset.
maintenance_bk_legacy_tip: Comes from an older version and can’t be restored
maintenance_st_compact_text: The database will be cleaned up. Afterward, all signed-in browsers renew their local cache, so the next load there takes a little longer.
maintenance_st_desc: Cleans up the database and has all browsers renew their local cache.
maintenance_mode_desc: Temporarily locks the app for everyone except administrators.
maintenance_mode_desc_mobile: Locks the app for everyone except administrators.
maintenance_msg_desc: Appears on the sign-in page while maintenance is in progress
dev_expire_text: You were inactive for a while. Sign in again to continue.
notice_stale_many: {n} accounts haven’t been checked in a while.
notice_offline_text: Changes will sync once you’re back online.

offline_wait_many: {count} changes pending. They’ll sync as soon as you’re back online.
offline_lost_one: Your change to “{subject}” was discarded. The server version was kept.
offline_lost_many: {count} changes were discarded. The server version was kept.
offline_draft_one: “{subject}” was changed on another device. Your version is in Drafts as a new draft.

dev_level_desc: Which entries appear in the log

dev_logerr_desc_mobile: Test entry at the error level
